[b]v0.5.42 — Generic Blueprint SkillEffect source attribution[/b]
[list]
[*]The native bridge now reads the owning AttackFilter from any synchronously executing Blueprint SkillEffect, using its attacker and Waza ID as exact source identity. This is engine-wide and does not name a skill or require a fixed loadout.
[*]This covers the reported 22 Psychokinesis hits totalling 235,365 and also applies to other skills that use the same engine pattern.
[*]Effect class, synchronous attacker/target, Filter ownership and Waza are all validated. A mismatch stays unresolved; damage, element, loadout or a general current/recent action still cannot choose a skill by themselves.
[*]The native bridge was rebuilt against the pinned UE4SS ABI. UI assets, UE4SS and PalSchema are unchanged. Offline regressions passed; live acceptance follows the Steam update.
[/list]
[b]Update the existing subscription; do not install a separate test copy. Fully exit Palworld, wait for Steam to update, restart, then press F2 before retesting.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[b]v0.5.42 — Blueprint SkillEffect 來源通用歸屬[/b]
[list]
[*]原生橋接現在會讀取任何正在同步執行之 Blueprint SkillEffect 自有的 AttackFilter，以其中的攻擊者與 Waza ID 建立精確來源；這是引擎層通用規則，不綁技能名稱或固定配招。
[*]此修正涵蓋本次回報中 22 筆、合計 235,365 的念動引力傷害，也適用於其他使用相同引擎流程的技能。
[*]效果類別、同步攻擊者／目標、Filter 所屬物件與 Waza 都必須通過驗證；任一不符就維持未歸屬。傷害、屬性、配招或一般目前／最近動作仍不能單獨選擇技能。
[*]原生橋接已依鎖定的 UE4SS ABI 重新編譯；UI 資產、UE4SS 與 PalSchema 不變。離線回歸通過，實戰驗收待 Steam 更新後進行。
[/list]
[b]沿用原訂閱，不要另外安裝內測檔。請完整退出 Palworld，等待 Steam 更新後重開，再按 F2 重新測試。[/b]
